messages:
Jordan: Quick oxygen-breaker: if you could add one totally silly superpower to the office (no coding help, purely vibes), what would it be? Keep it under 10 words. :sparkles:
Priya: Instant perfect-coffee materializer at your desk. Zero queues. :coffee:
Sam: Meetings that auto-shrink to 12 minutes when everyone nods. :clock12:
Elliot: A quiet bubble you can activate that mutes Slack pings for 30m. :zipper_mouth_face:
Carmen: Hovering plant that brings you snacks on demand. :herb: :chip:
ops-bot: Poll created  React with 1 = coffee, 2 = meeting shrinker, 3 = mute-bubble, 4 = snack-plant
Jordan: Also shoutout: if anyone actually builds the coffee materializer please patent it and share equity. :grin:
Priya: Low-key vote :one: but I'd share the snacks. :handshake:
Sam: :two: because my calendar is a black hole. :grinning_face_with_sweat:
Elliot: :three: legit lifesaver for heads-down sprints. :raised_hands:
Carmen: :four: because workplace wildlife improves morale. Rubber duck not included. :duck:
Jordan: GIF: https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6ZtpxSZbQRRnwCKQ/giphy.gif "office magic"
Priya: Bonus: what would the activation phrase be? Mine: "Perkify!"
Sam: Mine: "Compress, or I compress you." :joking_face:
Elliot: "Do Not Disturb, But Make It Fashion."
Carmen: "Snack-O-Rama engage." :tada:
Jordan: Alright poll closing in an hour. Results will determine our imaginary office upgrade roadmap. Thanks for the nonsense. :seedling:
